initiative.name: TS→Rust Migration — Stage 2: Port TUI Layer
initiative.objective: Port the tui-repl subsystem to idiomatic Rust in the night-agent-runner-tui crate. 4 porter teammates split by UI concern work in parallel on non-overlapping file sets.

teammates.name: porter-screens
teammates.objective: Port all screen files (screens/) to Ratatui Widget implementations in night-agent-runner-tui/src/screens/

teammates.name: porter-components
teammates.objective: Port all component files (components/) to Ratatui Widget + StatefulWidget implementations in night-agent-runner-tui/src/components/

teammates.name: porter-ink-hooks
teammates.objective: Port the Ink render layer and hooks (ink/, hooks/, ink.ts, replLauncher.tsx) to a Tokio event loop + Crossterm terminal driver in night-agent-runner-tui/src/runtime/

teammates.name: porter-dialogs
teammates.objective: Port dialog launchers and interactive helpers (dialogLaunchers.tsx, interactiveHelpers.tsx) to modal overlay implementations in night-agent-runner-tui/src/dialogs/
